Use the `extends` keyword after a type parameter to constrain it to a shape or interface, such as `<T extends Identifiable>`.
To ensure a property key belongs to an object type, constrain a second type parameter using `K extends keyof T`.
In `getProperty`, write the signature as `<T, K extends keyof T>(item: T, key: K): T[K]` and return `item[key]`.
